findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_formation_status, get_documents, agent_company_diagnostic · Private data: get_formation_requirements, recommend_structure, create_formation_request, create_standalone_company, get_documents, request_amendment, agent_company_diagnostic, reserve_company_name · Public sink: create_formation_request, request_amendment, agent_company_diagnostic, reserve_company_name · Destructive: recommend_structure, request_amendment.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_formation_status, get_documents, agent_company_diagnostic · Private data: get_formation_requirements, recommend_structure, create_formation_request, create_standalone_company, get_documents, request_amendment, agent_company_diagnostic, reserve_company_name · Public sink: create_formation_request, request_amendment, agent_company_diagnostic, reserve_company_name · Destructive: recommend_structure, request_amendment

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
